output.summary: A spurge native to western China, Kyrgyzstan and Pakistan, caper spurge is usually biennial but occasionally annual, with waxy blue-green stems and paired leaves. All parts, including the seeds and roots, are poisonous, and its latex may irritate skin.
output.edibilityNote: All parts, including seeds and roots, are poisonous to humans; toxins may also pass into milk from goats that eat it.
